title: PNP blocks 2 to 3 websites promoting violence amid school shootings
summary: Two to three websites have been blocked in the Philippines for allegedly promoting real-world violence and online grooming amid recent school-related threats, the Philippine National Police (PNP)…

blocks.text: Two to three websites have been blocked in the Philippines for allegedly promoting real-world violence and online grooming amid recent school-related threats, the Philippine National Police (PNP) said Monday.
PNP spokesperson Police Colonel Allen Rae Co said the police coordinated with the National Telecommunications Commission (NTC) and internet service providers for the blocking of the websites.

“We have already coordinated with the NTC for the blocking of certain websites espousing real world violence. And the response was positive, meron na pong mga blinock na ibang websites,” Co said at a press briefing.
(We have already coordinated with the NTC for the blocking of certain websites espousing real world violence. And the response was positive, there are other websites that are being blocked.)
“As far as we know ay nasa mga dalawa o tatlo,” he added.
(As far as we know, there are two or three.)
Co declined to identify the concerned websites as this move could generate more interest in the online platforms.
He said the blocking effort is ongoing as authorities continue to identify other websites that may contain similar content. —AOL, GMA News
